missions.name: The Lost Forge
missions.description: Ancient forges rumble beneath the mountains. Reclaim lost smithing knowledge from the depths.
missions.lore: The ancient dwarven forges were abandoned centuries ago. Now, emissaries brave enough venture into the depths to recover forgotten techniques of metalworking.

missions.name: Circle Interference Node
missions.description: Arcane nodes malfunction across the realm. Stabilize the magical interference before it spreads.
missions.lore: The Circle of Mist maintains arcane nodes that regulate magical flow. When these nodes malfunction, reality itself begins to fracture.

missions.name: Dawn Patrol
missions.description: Patrol the eastern borders as the sun rises. Defend settlements from nocturnal threats. [PARTY MISSION - 5 HEROES REQUIRED]
missions.lore: The Order of Dawn rises with the sun, ever vigilant against the shadows that retreat at first light. Simple patrol duty, yet essential to protect the realm. A coordinated party of five heroes can cover more ground and earn greater rewards.

missions.name: Shadow Infiltration
missions.description: Infiltrate enemy strongholds under cover of darkness. Gather intelligence without being detected.
missions.lore: The Shadow Guild operates where light fears to tread. Their agents move unseen, gathering secrets that could topple kingdoms.

missions.name: Horizon Survey
missions.description: Scout the uncharted territories beyond the known world. Map new routes and discover hidden dangers.
missions.lore: Horizon Watch stands at the edge of civilization, eyes fixed on the unknown. Their scouts venture where maps end, charting paths for future generations.

missions.name: Veil Breach Containment
missions.description: Reality tears open. Seal the breach before void entities pour through into our realm. [PARTY MISSION - 5 HEROES REQUIRED]
missions.lore: The Veil separates our world from the Void. When it tears, horrors beyond comprehension threaten to cross over. Only the Void Echoes understand these rifts well enough to seal them. This breach is massive - a full party of five heroes is required to contain it.

missions.name: Dragons Crucible
missions.description: Face the ancient dragon that guards the legendary forge. Only the strongest survive.
missions.lore: Deep beneath the mountains lies the Dragons Crucible, a forge so hot it was built around a slumbering dragon. Waking it means certain battle.

missions.name: Void Descent
missions.description: Descend into the Void itself. Confront entities that should not exist. Few return unchanged.
missions.lore: To truly understand the Void, one must walk within it. The Void Echoes send their most experienced members on these descents, seeking knowledge that exists beyond death itself.

missions.name: Eclipse Ritual
missions.description: Harness the power of a total eclipse. The ritual is dangerous, but the rewards transcendent. [PARTY MISSION - 5 HEROES REQUIRED]
missions.lore: When sun and moon align, the veil between worlds grows thin. The Circle of Mist performs forbidden rituals during these moments, tapping into cosmic power that could destroy the unprepared. The ritual requires five channelers working in perfect synchronicity.

first_death.description: First death is merciful. The ritual is simple.

second_death.description: Second death takes a toll. The spirits demand more.

third_death.description: Third death is severe. Your soul weakens with each return.

fourth_plus.description: Beyond the third death, the price becomes astronomical. Few can afford this.
